تحتسوا (form VIII)
# تَحْتَسُوا (taḥtasū) /taħ.ta.suː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَسَى (iḥtasā)
# تُحْتَسَوْا (tuḥtasaw) /tuħ.ta.saw/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَسَى (iḥtasā)
